name: google/grr
description: GRR Rapid Response is a remote live forensics framework for incident response comprising a Python agent deployed on target systems and server infrastructure for managing investigations. Enables scalable remote evidence collection and forensic triage across large fleets.
score_rationale: Google-backed remote live forensics framework with 5k stars reaching a major 4.0 milestone in December 2025, widely used in enterprise incident response.
